title: Mouse Sailing on Crimson Tide
description: A giant purple mouse with glowing spiral eyes and intricate patterns swims through dark turbulent waters, its long tail curling behind it. A small sailing ship rests on its back with two silhouetted figures, one raising arms toward a massive blood-red moon that illuminates the night sky over a fantastical sea filled with stylized aquatic plants and smaller swimming mice.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a giant ornate purple mouse with glowing spiral eyes swimming through a dark stormy ocean at night, a wooden sailing ship with two human silhouettes standing on its back, massive blood-red moon dominating the sky with its reflection on the water, stylized colorful aquatic plants and smaller mice in the foreground, intricate decorative patterns, mystical atmosphere, rich vibrant colors with dark background
